text.tspan: Deaths from famines by main trigger and decade World
Deaths from famines that are estimated to have killed 100,000 people or more. The World Peace Foundation's
triggers seek to summarize the established view among scholars.

tspan.tspan: The figures are the sum of famine deaths over each ten-year period (e.g., 1990–1999 for the 1990s). The 2020s figure is provisional and

text.tspan: includes data only up to and including 2023.
